answer: The comet schedule is applied in timber and horizon publishes each instalment. A payout is split thus 26% arrives at settlement and the rest over 20 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. An hostile operator thus cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 1970 identities would post 4145 proofs and burn roughly 40 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
